title: Game-Theoretic Discovery of Productive Advantage

offering.buyer: A software maintainer deciding how to investigate an upstream dependency transition in a specified public consumer scope.
offering.need: Translate raw consumer/dependency source into a source-linked, complete scoped call review with a practical next action.
offering.deliverable: Captured-source intake, exact selected-call requests, unchanged AGI ALPHA binding verification, complete relevant-call inventory audit, explicit unresolved evidence, EN/FR report and cost provenance.
offering.claimBoundary: Source-level argument-binding decisions and explicit missing evidence, not runtime behavior, security, application adoption or release approval.
offering.recurrence: Public package/source changes and existing internal maintenance needs are observable. Paid demand and weekly customer recurrence are unmeasured.
alternatives: Competent maintainer using AST/search and test tooling

diagnosis.incumbent: The actual product already implements deterministic source/binding checks. Its intake needs a curator-produced alpha-upgrade-call-request/v1.
diagnosis.earlierProductionBurden: The prior 61-case workflow's roughly 15-second mandatory timeout test dominates turnaround. It is preserved and is not the target of this experiment.
diagnosis.interventionBurden: Caller identification, exact declaration selection and mechanical source-pack preparation before the existing verifier.
diagnosis.commercialBottleneck: Prior primary zero adoption was also affected by alternatives, trust/integration assumptions, finite reserves and a subsequently diagnosed pricing heuristic. Intake automation need not solve these.

externalMethod.name: DUPLEX-inspired source intake
externalMethod.classification: Adaptation of model-driven information extraction followed by deterministic exact planning/checking. Not a faithful reproduction of Qwen/PDDL/Fast Downward or household/IPC results.
externalMethod.ours: Raw-source schema, frozen extraction prompt, source-bound compiler, existing core adapter, complete-scope oracle and cost/market bridge.
expectedFailure: Constructors/descriptors/expanded calls unsupported by the unchanged core
No benefit over equally equipped ordinary tools
Unknown model bills or upkeep dominating saved effort

arms.A: Actual unchanged product core supplied by current-session curator inspection and an explicitly prepared call request; existing tools/caches remain available. Curator effort is not measured human labor. The follow-up uses the same common handoff correction in all arms; the core and curator-input contract are unchanged.
arms.B: Prospective current-session model extraction under the frozen prompt, reusable compiler and unchanged deterministic core. Raw prompt/response/errors retained; extraction billing unknown. The original frozen extraction prompt/compiler remain unchanged; only common delivery packaging is corrected.
arms.C: C2: retained original conventional implementation plus a separately versioned source-export resolver; same source-backed conditional declaration permissions as A/B, same unchanged core and common complete packager. No runtime model.

candidateFreeze: Before raw confirmation inputs are exposed to the constructor or extraction role; exact module/prompt hashes recorded in candidate-freeze.json.

taskSelection.owner: Separate same-session production audit role; no candidate outcomes used in selection.
families: Fresh consumer components independently selected from public numerical/network/CLI dependency use
taskSelection.sources: Four different new consumer-component/transition packages, no reused primary consumer scope; selected before candidate outcomes. Independent source selection protocol specifies exact Git bodies.
taskSelection.scope: Named top-level function/class/method scopes, at most 24 relevant calls each; full files and required export modules retained.
taskSelection.freshness: Previously unseen to this study's constructor/extractor. Historical public code may be in model pretraining. Cases sharing source or transition are clustered and not independent defect families.
taskSelection.unit: One scoped consumer-component/transition package is one maintenance question. Four jobs are not representative market demand.

acceptance.frozenSeparately: Independent complete-scope reference inventory and source-grounded verdict expectations before candidate evaluation.
required: Every dependency-relevant call in scope represented exactly once
Exact source identity, location and declaration evidence
Binding conflicts, preservation and unresolved scope distinguished
Action appropriate to scope and substantive evidence
Complete EN/FR handoff for every arm including all-unresolved cases
Exact consumer snippet and immutable public source link for every relevant call
Named consumer-relevant next action and retained runtime/behavior qualifications
Every referenced local artifact exists; source inputs and cost unknowns are attached
No acceptance based only on inventory when supported substantive evidence is missing without justification
measures: Decisive supported bindings versus complete unresolved outcomes
Model/curator interaction counts and unknown bills
acceptance.reviewDiscipline: Creator emits a proposal; critic searches original sources for consequential errors; verifier substantiates each criticism from source. Agreement alone is insufficient.
acceptance.independence: Separate same-session selection/oracle/audit role, blinded to arm outputs until campaign seal; no institutional or field validation.

execution.runtime: Unchanged createWorkbench(adapters) source closure at eb07086ac42799ff45f7b1c946a2f7c514bd3bbc; finite local source-only adapter.
execution.runs: One scheduled run per arm/package. Preserve every failure, partial completion and refusal. No efficacy reruns or outcome-based task substitution.
execution.modelAttempts: One first attempt; at most one syntax/schema-only correction without outcome/oracle feedback, charged and retained.
execution.limits: 30-second child bound; original Workbench 60-second bound and HOLD/empty authority/disconnected settlement remain unchanged.
execution.baselineFirst: Exposed historical product example produces a usable HOLD_UPDATE_AND_TEST report before intervention confirmation; not counted as fresh work.
execution.analysis: Primary and follow-up reported separately. Descriptive paired counts only; four purposive historical packages cannot establish a population error rate or significance.
execution.stopping: One follow-up campaign, no outcome-dependent candidate edits, reruns or substitutions. Failures remain failures; no additional tuning against these four jobs.

economics.ledger: Use canonical existing cost/shadow-ledger APIs and unchanged prior histories; one new exact-asset account, no invented operating receipts.
economics.resourceInstrument: resources/account-opening.json and command receipts precede construction. Discovery already performed and all authoring/inference/attention bills unavailable are explicit unknowns.
economics.noConversions: Do not convert elapsed agent time into a human wage bill or call counts into saved customer minutes.
economics.fullCost: Discovery, both builders, unsuccessful attempts, inference, tools, execution, checking, correction, integration, packaging, upkeep and residual attention included as quantities/unknowns.
economics.financedAsset: Exactly the tested retained B or C2 closure, including its inherited construction, failures and common packager allocation; no unrelated successor.
economics.market: Prespecified 166-cell conditional grid remains unchanged. Complete independently accepted equivalent work is required; unknown actual bills continue IDENTIFICATION_HOLD even if conditional scenarios run.
economics.scenarioProtocol: Separate prospective freeze after production but before market outputs. Explicit conditional cost assumptions only; unknown full bills yield identification HOLD.

promotion.engineeringTransfer: Reproducible useful fresh-source intake through actual runtime with complete-scope acceptance; report advantage over A and C separately.
promotion.economicImprovement: Requires complete incremental cost below benefits over defensible recurrence; unknown cost/effort prevents identified repayment.
promotion.modeledFlywheel: Requires same tested asset funded from available modeled operating resources, incremental repayment and another justified tested investment; none invented.
promotion.realizedFlywheel: Requires actual accepted work, collections and reconciled costs; not established by this study.

priorPrimary.reason: Primary C used stricter target proof than A/B; all primary handoffs incomplete. Original results are retained and never reclassified as this follow-up.

structuralHypotheses.hypothesis: Model extraction plus deterministic compilation can complete source intake; incremental advantage over actual incumbent and competent ordinary tooling must be demonstrated, not inferred from architecture.
structuralHypotheses.disproof: Equivalent quality/coverage from ordinary tooling without model stage, or missing complete handoff, or costs exceed benefit.

structuralHypotheses.hypothesis: Equal conditional target permissions and reusable ordinary source traversal can remove the repeated model extraction step on fresh public consumer scopes.
structuralHypotheses.disproof: Any material omission, wrong target, unjustified abstention preventing equivalent useful acceptance, or complete incremental cost exceeding defensible recurring benefit.
